required_upstream: Action/Event, Character, World/Scene, Combat, Inventory/Asset, Vehicle and Project owner contracts available
boundaries: GPR is the reusable gameplay-pattern execution and loop-composition layer; it does not become a second Character, World, Scene, Combat, Inventory, Economy, Project, Action/Event or content-definition ledger

MAL-01..10 remain completed_verified and frozen as the original microgame/ambient-loop foundation; GPR extends to full reusable gameplay patterns and may consume MAL contracts without reopening or rewriting MAL completion evidence
MRCS remains reusable rule/content-definition authority; GPR executes accepted definitions and pattern compositions rather than becoming a second Content Forge
ARI retains resource identity, source/derivative lineage, rights/use capability and imported/generated media provenance
MCS, MCCS, MNCS, MAS and MSAS retain map, appearance, NPC/creature, adventure and audio authoring authority; GPR binds their accepted outputs without absorbing those owner domains
source-ROM assets, commercial screenshots, maps, sprite sheets, music and third-party protected expression remain reference/evidence only and may never become a production dependency
runtime code consumes semantic operation, primitive, pattern and asset-role IDs; source-game names, ROM offsets and copyrighted presentation are not runtime rule identities
the seven supported delivery modes are direct play, cozy play, GM-led play, world-map/TTRPG bridge, embedded minigame, user-authored loop mini and Multiversal roster injection
cozy behavior is parameterized through timer/aggression/resource/retry/hint policies rather than a forked rules engine
GM intervention uses governed state/configuration operations and typed outcomes rather than hidden bespoke GM-only logic
world/TTRPG and embedded-minigame resolutions use explicit success/partial/failure outcomes plus typed resource, condition, reward, map and story deltas
roster injection maps Character-owned stats, equipment, abilities and conditions into pattern slots without replacing Character identity or canonical state
original or otherwise rights-cleared presentation assets bind through semantic asset roles; mechanics never depend on one skin or copyrighted reference art
replay, snapshot and migration are versioned and deterministic for the governed state/command stream where the module declares determinism
multiplayer/co-op operations declare authority/ownership and may not depend on hidden local frame order
the v3.6 reference runtime and 175-game corpus are planning/conformance provenance, not automatically shippable application code or content
no GPR implementation branch or implementation authority exists until separately governed start
